title: Withdrawing What a Resident Trust Fund Accounts Account Can Spare
content:
## Policy

When the resident or legal representative asks to withdraw what the account can spare, the withdrawal request asks for the spare amount, and the money is paid afterwards under the withdrawal rules, by check where it is more than the petty cash maximum.

This applies to every Resident Trust Fund Accounts tier. The request is an open withdrawal request on the account: its purpose and signer are already on file and its amount is left open until the spare amount is entered and signed.

## When the spare amount is worked out

The spare amount is not worked out until the account's ledger carries a transfer naming the patient pay charge of the latest service month that a standing authorization for patient pay covers, where that month's patient pay is not yet settled and the account has funds available for it.

The spare amount is fixed only after the account's ledger carries a wrong-amount return for the most recent transfer to a bed-hold charge, where part of that transfer paid more than the hold's own rules let the charge bill.

Before the spare amount is worked out, the account's ledger must carry a wrong-amount return for the most recent transfer to a Medicare coinsurance charge, where part of that transfer paid coinsurance the resident did not owe for the block the charge priced.

## Signing the amount: `sign_withdrawal_request_c6615816`

This is the customer's own tool. Unlock it and hand it over; the customer themselves enters and signs the amount on the open withdrawal request. The call writes the amount asked for onto that request, which then stands as a signed request for that amount. No money moves and the account balance is unchanged when it is signed; the signer sees the request, with its amount, on the account's list of signed requests.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trust_account_id` | the resident funds account the money is to come from, as shown on the account record | identifier |
| `trust_request_id` | the open withdrawal request whose amount is being entered, as shown in the account's list of signed requests | identifier |
| `amount` | the money asked for | US dollars, a positive decimal number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, no currency sign |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Withdrawal request <request> on account <account> signed for <amount> USD." The request reference with its amount shows that the amount was recorded.
